rationale: The workflow already caches its primary dependencies: every Ruby job uses ruby/setup-ruby with bundler-cache: true (gem/vendor bundle cache), and the lint job already has an actions/cache step for the RuboCop cache. The closest supported evidence pattern (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE / P-LIT-DISTRIBUTED-CACHE: add actions/cache for dependency downloads) is therefore already satisfied; adding another dependency cache would be redundant and matches that pattern's contraindication "An equivalent cache already exists." Other patterns do not apply: there is no matrix (fail-fast/cancel-stale are not relevant), there is no measured duration history to set a safe custom timeout (the test job runs Postgres, libvips install, Tailwind build, and rspec, so a guessed timeout risks failing valid slow runs), and change-filter/test-selection patterns could reduce required-check coverage (required_checks are not verified). No new network access, secrets, or privileged actions are introduced. No supported optimization is applicable, so NO_CHANGE.
